name: computer-use
description: Drive the host computer's mouse, keyboard, and screen from the agent via computer-use-mcp — a near-clone of Anthropic's Computer Use API installable with one npx. Single `computer` tool with 11 actions.

interface.shortDescription: Give the agent control of the local computer's mouse, keyboard, and screen.
interface.longDescription: The Computer Use skill wraps domdomegg/computer-use-mcp, a near-clone of Anthropic's official Computer Use API installable with one `npx` and driven by nut.js. It exposes a single `computer` tool with 11 actions: `key`, `type`, `mouse_move`, `left_click`, `left_click_drag`, `right_click`, `middle_click`, `double_click`, `scroll`, `get_cursor_position`, and `get_screenshot`. Works on macOS, Windows, and Linux (uses `xdotool` on Linux for keyboard layout safety; falls back to `screencapture` on macOS 26+). WARNING: gives the model complete control of the host machine — use only in a sandboxed user account and only when `playwright` (browser) or `chrome` (real Chrome) cannot do the job. Reaches for the entire desktop GUI: clicking icons, opening applications, filling forms, dragging windows, taking screenshots.
defaultPrompt: Use the Computer Use skill only when no browser (playwright / chrome) or API skill can do the job — it gives the model complete control of the host machine.
Always start with `get_screenshot` and read the red crosshair to derive click coordinates. Never guess pixel positions from memory.
Prefer keyboard shortcuts over visual targeting. Use 720p resolution for the best results.
Run inside a sandboxed user account, VM, or disposable profile.
